title: 2017-18 Panini Prizm Mosaic Red #66 Eric Bledsoe
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2017-18 Panini Prizm Mosaic Red #66 Eric Bledsoe sports trading card. It features Eric Bledsoe of the Milwaukee Bucks, who plays in the National Basketball Association (NBA). The card is an original and is in near mint/mint condition. It is part of a set from Panini Prizm Mosaic and was manufactured by the Panini Group in 2017. The card has a red parallel/variety and is a single trading card. The season is 2017-18 and the period is modern (1970-Now). The card number is 66 and it is a product of the sports trading card type.
